title: Brazil Is Clearing The Amazon Slower, But It Adds Up
hook: The clearing is dropping. The damage isn't.
closing: Fewer trees fall each year. The bill still grows.
question: Give up beef to save the rainforest?

segments.say: By 2024, yearly Amazon clearing in Brazil had fallen to just 6,288 square kilometers, the lowest in nearly a decade.
Adding up every year since 1970, the Amazon has lost about 750,000 square kilometers total.
Close to 80 percent of all that cleared Amazon land becomes cattle pasture.
